image_prompt:
A distinguished middle-aged man in cyberpunk anime style, rendered with sharp angular features and piercing, intelligent eyes that betray quiet intellectual exhaustion. He has silver-streaked dark hair swept back with austere precision, complemented by a severe, angular jawline bearing subtle signs of age and worry. His face carries the weight of authority and loss—deep lines etched from years of diplomatic burden and diminished circumstances.

Dressed in high-collared formal ecclesiastical robes merged with neo-gothic cyberpunk elements: sleek black fabric with metallic silver threading and geometric patterns, adorned with ornate silver religious insignia that gleams with technological precision. His collar is starched and rigid, accentuating his formal bearing. Intricate circuit-pattern embroidery traces down his garments, blending religious authority with futuristic aesthetic.

His build is lean and upright, maintaining rigid Prussian posture despite inner melancholy. His hands, visible and refined, suggest scholarly pursuits. Expression is stoic yet haunted—the countenance of a man who sacrificed his own children to circumstance, viewed through the cold, emotionless lens of cyberpunk anime illustration. Every line conveys austere dignity fractured by ironic detachment.
book_context: Catherine the Great: A Life (or similar biographical work on Catherine II)
